what: S2-4 provisioned per-episode tariff q for JevAgentRL (docs/PREREG_A7_STAGE2.md A7.13 (iii)), measured as the S2-4S tariff (results/stage2/tariff_sl4b_plan.json)

configuration.profile: configs/harness/jevagent_best.yaml (Flash section with the fitted backends.jevagent_rl block, A7.1 (f))
configuration.system1: JevAgentRL (the frozen checkpoint of results/gpu_round5/FREEZE_RECORD.json: Qwen/Qwen3-4B + its LoRA adapter and temperature file) served by training/serve_jev.py on :8081 under the name jevagentrl-4b: session cache on, multi-question suffix batching on, serve_jev defaults otherwise

warmup.purpose: the server's first requests (CUDA allocation, session cache) outside the window; not counted

workload.task_seeds: 600-699 (the S2-4S tariff's seeds, so the two tariffs are measured on one workload)

window.start: the UTC time the workload command is launched (after the warm-up)
window.end: the UTC time the workload command exits
window.contents: only the workload: no other job runs on the GPU host inside the window; executor waiting and provisioned idle time inside it are included

host.price_source: AWS Price List API (AmazonEC2, Linux, shared tenancy, on demand), read 2026-10-03

formula: q = host $/h x (window end - window start) / completed development episodes (latest record without an infrastructure error); scripts/stage2_tariff.py --arm jevagent_best_rl --served-model jevagentrl-4b --out results/stage2/tariff.json
served_model_price: jevagentrl-4b is an exact 0 per-token entry in configs/prices/models.yaml (nothing charged twice)
sensitivity: busy-throughput tariff (union of in-flight System-1 calls x host $/h / episodes), Jev's API price ($0.042 / M System-1 input tokens), $0, and the realised evaluation-host bill beside it (A7.13 (iii))
note: A7.7 and A7.10 (h) planned the JevAgentRL serving on one L4; the persistent Stage-2 host is the L40S that served StartLux (one box for the whole remaining GPU chain), so q is that host's tariff, its hardware recorded with it (dated Deviations entry)
